A candidate for the error journal (Q13; for DOC-UPDATER, next free AP number by its own count). Row B6's «Red after it» named the test that compares the real file's findings with nothing (CIW-1). It did not name the second test of the same file, which builds its damaged and green copies from the real file and asserts the green ones clean (CIW-2), although both read the same constants that the row changes. The list was written without a run of the guard file on the changed file: F50 measured the reds after B3 only. This is the shape of AP-112 and AP-113, guard tests named without reading or running them. How to do it right: for every sub-step that changes a file which a guard test reads, the design measures its «Red after it» on the sketch with that file changed (as F50 did for B3), and lists every test of the guard file that reads it, the copy-building ones included.
